overview.title: Application performance
overview.subtitle: Analyze backend performance through services, Transactions, and Traces.
overview.high_impact_services_description: Services ranked by traffic, errors, and latency in the selected window.
overview.high_impact_transactions_description: Find this service's problematic entry points by total time, traffic, errors, and latency.
overview.dependencies_description: Slow or error-prone downstream calls with the greatest impact.
overview.top_errors_description: Sanitized error groups ranked by occurrence count.
overview.slowest_traces_description: Representative slow requests retained from the current aggregate window.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Discover instrumented and standalone backend services.
services.transactions_description: Highest-impact entry points for this service.
services.dependencies_description: Downstream calls made by this service.
services.errors_description: Sanitized backend error groups affecting this service.

runtime.title: Runtime and instrumentation
runtime.subtitle: Inspect this service's runtime, OpenTelemetry SDK, and active instances.
runtime.description: Based on the latest service resource attributes observed in the selected time, environment, and version scope.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.subtitle: Analyze performance changes with deployment versions and contextual comparisons.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Rank entry points by traffic, errors, latency, and total time.
transactions.detail_subtitle: Transactions are independently analyzable application operations such as endpoints, jobs, and message handlers.
transactions.ranking_description: Percentiles are computed from merged fixed-boundary histograms.
transactions.errors_description: Sanitized backend error groups associated with this Transaction.
transactions.deployments_description: Inspect observed service versions and compare performance before and after deployment.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.subtitle: Inspect aggregate downstream service, database, cache, messaging, HTTP, and RPC calls.
dependencies.safe_topology_description: Only bounded aggregate identities are displayed; raw destinations and request values are never exposed.

errors.title: Backend errors
errors.subtitle: Investigate sanitized backend exception groups and their service impact.
errors.groups_description: Messages and stacks are bounded and scrubbed before persistence.
errors.sanitized_stack_description: Application frames are normalized and sensitive values are removed.
errors.no_samples: No retained samples in this time window.

versions.title: Version compare
versions.subtitle: Compare two service versions using absolute and relative RED deltas.
versions.selection_description: Choose one service, a baseline, and a different candidate version.
versions.configure_description: Enter a service filter, then select two distinct observed versions.
versions.type_service_hint: Enter a service above to load observed versions.
versions.status_sufficient: Both versions meet the minimum sample threshold.
versions.status_insufficient: This comparison is neutral until both versions meet the sample threshold.

trend.title: Application trends
trend.throughput_subtitle: Requests per second normalized by aggregate bucket.
trend.latency_subtitle: P50, P95, and P99 latency percentiles.
trend.error_rate_subtitle: Request error rate in each aggregate bucket.

quality.activation_title: APM data starts inside this window
quality.activation_description: Projection started at {{time}}; earlier data is not available.
quality.partial_description: {{count}} projection gaps affect this window. Aggregates remain available but may be lower than actual traffic.
quality.stale_description: The latest complete bucket ended at {{time}}. Values remain visible while projection catches up.
quality.impact_description: Throughput, error rate, latency trends, and impact rankings may be lower than actual values; existing aggregates remain useful for investigation.

states.filtered_empty_description: Change or clear the current service, environment, version, or search filters.
